Sadly, it was a beautiful day, Rick.
It’s – I call it the World Bidet.

Selfish Karl. So selfish. And you've lost us a Sony.

Bad audience, bad time, bad audience. Tough crowd.

... so he's just like, walking 'round, I dunno, Hyde Park...
... feeding ducks, when he should be working out what he can do instead of Rockbusters, which is basically Blockbusters with a word changed.

q: At The Fat Duck in Bray, voted best restaurant in the world, what did they put in fussy Ricky's version of the snail porridge?

ex: And uh, uh, me and Jane went along with him and Jane to The Fat Duck in Bray. It was voted the best restaurant in the world.

Okay. And um, it was incredible. I mean, it's a cross between a restaurant and sort of barnum. They take you, just, incredible, but all the way there, I'm thinking well I, I, I can't eat stuff in normal restaurants. I can't eat, I don't…
I, it was, I knew that one of their, um, signature dishes was snail porridge. So I'm thinking "I'm not gonna be able to eat anything here." So I'm thinking I had something to eat before I went.

I was thinking that they better not have mucked around the bread, right? Got there. Beautiful. Um, and uh, it was, it was, it was really quite fantastic. And, and I let them know straight away, um, that I was a philistine and they really…

They put um, mushrooms in my snail porridge, which was more risotto, and its tasting menus and that, and it was, it was, um, uh, really fantastic. But, Jonathan halfway through on the way there, I don't like travel well, on the way there…

Which is hardly cooked, followed by lamb.

A deckchair being put up by a drunk

You were defending with it a cross between a giant lizard and a stick insect.
Again, because they don't sound straight away, they don't sound like compliments, but I'm assuming you're on my side here.
Stick insect with funny glasses, is that again.

That's never happened. They go and put nuts in the salt water to salt the nut, whatever. How does that, how does that get to peeling potatoes? Because in your head they were working in a canteen making chips. Yeah, definitely, yeah.
It doesn't matter what the food is. I'm just saying how they know how to sort of prepare.

I love the fact that you don't care what the fact is when you're discussing facts. That's all that matters. Otherwise on Mastermind, they just go, who wrote Much Ado about Nothing? Dickens. Yeah, close enough. Whatever someone did, the…
Yeah, but with that question, that's got a straightforward answer. What I'm telling you is the way that animals work, if it's a potato or a nut, it's a foodage.

q: According to Ricky, what was fashionable among rich Victorians?

It was fashionable to have a little, like a little homeless little hobbit in your, in your outhouse. Seriously!
And what did they have, did they have to do anything for the money? Run, dance, fight tigers?
No, they just had to be there. No, they had to be there when they brought around. They'd go, "Look, that's our, that's our little Catweazel fella living in our folly."
And then they were. They got money, you know, at the end of it, there's just like, really rich sort of Victorians and stuff.

The one knock-back, and that was it.

To present the next show in a suit

If just one employee turns out to be simian and is doing a good job? I'm never doing this radio show again.
So this TV channel, you know, it's having a lot of problems and that. They've got to go live, right? He's like, what am I gonna do? Anyway, for some reason, right, there was a chimp knocking about.

But I've never done that before, I mean I've never, I've sworn before but never accidentally, and we were being interviewed for erm, and Christian was sort of like quite, you know, being a bit boisterous and he must have brought out the…

People were calling up going “what about 'Drive' by The Cars”, he was going 'Drive by The Cars very good', and it was like, er, thing like, you know what I mean, things like, something tee and that, and I wanted to phone up and go “Hello.…
